limits: Literal methods and real Fastify injection; no full upstream boot, PostgreSQL, Redis server or network.
Repository/QueryBuilder/Redis doubles implement only the finite source predicates and facts. JS ASCII ordering does not establish PostgreSQL collation.
Actual Note/Create/Announce/collection/MFM renderers and context; file/poll/user/emoji repositories are doubles.

Fastify root options are literal; ActivityPub createServer installs its own hooks. Global ServerService hooks, HTML frontend, redirects policy, production security headers and full error diagnostic strings are excluded.
JSON error bodies retain statusCode/error only; empty bodies and text responses remain exact. Events are source traces, not product architecture requirements.
